authority.user_instruction: Prepare, verify, publish, and independently audit IncidentSeal v0.1.0 as a portable local-first release without changing the product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, evidence semantics, or explicit human gates.

scope.objective: Freeze, build, evaluate, publish, download, and independently verify a polished v0.1.0 GitHub and GHCR release from checkpoint-is-0005.
forbidden_work: Changing the approved product promise, manifest authority, Docker trust boundary, stable machine CLI semantics, or evidence-state distinctions
Giving any container a Docker socket or API socket, secret, privileged mode, host network, broad host mount, or external runtime network by default
Publishing or mirroring any image while redistribution remains INCONCLUSIVE or required notices and NOASSERTION entries are unresolved
Using mutable image tags as authority or publishing an image that is not source-gated, digest-pinned, scanned, SBOM-bound, provenance-bound, and runtime-verified
Using an unpinned GitHub Action, build backend, scanner, attestation tool, or release dependency
Adding PyPI, a paid service, user-managed secret, external credential, cloud platform, Kubernetes, multi-tenancy, or arbitrary remote execution
Enabling immutable releases, changing repository or package access, or taking another irreversible action without the exact human gate
Publishing a tag, image, asset, or release before its candidate gates pass
Claiming release completion from tests, source inspection, local tags, mutable tags, registry upload, or draft metadata alone
Shipping an artifact, image, release note, or public claim that cannot be independently downloaded and verified
reversible_actions: Freeze version, package, artifact, image, action, attestation, scan, reproducibility, and release-verification contracts
Add source-gated and digest-pinned packaging, build, scan, SBOM, provenance, and release dependencies
Build deterministic wheel and source-distribution candidates and verify them in fresh isolated environments
Build exact local OCI image candidates from pinned sources and verify all real topology, database, runner, dashboard, receipt, and recovery surfaces
Create digest-pinned GitHub workflow candidates that use only repository-scoped GITHUB_TOKEN authority
Create clean-clone and downloaded-artifact evaluators, release notes, checksums, notices, SBOMs, provenance, scan reports, and receipts
Commit and push verified bounded improvements
stop_conditions: A required change would alter the product promise, trust boundary, workflow approval authority, stable machine contract, or weaken an explicit security or evidence gate
An image or dependency cannot pass source, integrity, license, vulnerability, compatibility, and redistribution gates appropriate to its use
A build or release path requires a paid service, user-managed secret, real sensitive data, access or ownership change, or broader credential authority
Immutable-release enablement or another irreversible publication step is ready without exact owner confirmation
A candidate cannot reproduce from clean public custody or a published artifact cannot be independently downloaded and verified
A public claim would exceed the exact retained evidence
